Maria (Finance): FYI — BlueWave flagged their month-end bill, saying committed capacity invoices look off. They claim we billed full commit but actually consumed ~60% in Mar. Can finance confirm cutoff policy for commit refunds/deferrals? Link to contract + usage: https://redwood.internal/drive/BlueWave_Mar_usage.xlsx
Elliot (Billing Ops): I see why — billing pipeline had a manual override on 2024-03-31 that forced full-commit invoice. That override was for a previous spike and wasn’t cleared. Working on a corrected invoice but need rev-rec input for month-end JE.
Sasha (Revenue Mgmt): We should treat the overbilled portion as deferred revenue until actual usage in April/May consumes it, per contract. If contract term still open, prorate recognition over remaining term. Need exact amounts to size the deferral.
Ben (RevOps): Can someone confirm the overbilled amount? I pulled the sheet — looks like $48,250 of unused commit in March. Confirm?
Elliot (Billing Ops): Confirmed: invoice #BW-2024-03-998 shows $120k commit; actual consumption billed-by-usage would be $71,750. Delta = $48,250.
Raj (CS): BlueWave paused a staging cluster on Mar 18 — they acknowledged reduced usage in renewal call. They want a credit or deferral; prefer deferral to avoid PO headaches.
Maria (Finance): Ok. For month-end close we need: 1) journal to defer $48,250 from Revenue (GL 4001) to Deferred Revenue (GL 2302) with memo referencing BW contract; 2) corrected invoice to be issued for customer records. Who can approve the JE?
Sasha (Revenue Mgmt): Approve deferral approach. Use recognition schedule starting Apr 1 for remaining 6 months of term (prorated). GLs: Rev reduction = 4001, Deferral = 2302, expected future recognition to 4002 when recognized.
Elliot (Billing Ops): I'll queue the corrected invoice and mark original as 'superseded' in billing system. ETA EOD. Need the JE numbers and sign-off to post.
Maria (Finance): Draft JE below — please review. If ok, I'll route to Finance Director for sign-off.
```
Date: 2024-03-31
DR 4001 Revenue - Hosted API: $48,250
CR 2302 Deferred Revenue - Commit Credits: $48,250
Memo: BlueWave commit overbilling correction; invoice BW-2024-03-998 superseded; defer until consumption.
```
Ben (RevOps): JE looks right. Please include customer PO #BW-PO-778 and link to contract id BW-CTR-332 in memo. :thumbsup:
acct-bot: Journal request created: JR-2024-0917 (pending approval). Auditor note: attach corrected invoice and contract amendment if any.
Maria (Finance): Thanks. I'll add PO & contract links, submit JR-2024-0917 for approval, and confirm once corrected invoice is sent. Looping @Sasha for final sign-off and @Elliot for invoice delivery.
Sasha (Revenue Mgmt): Signed off from rev recognition perspective. Sasha approved.
Elliot (Billing Ops): Corrected invoice issued to accounting@bluewave.com, subject: "Corrected March Commit Billing (BW-2024-03-998 corrected)". CC'd Raj.
Raj (CS): Customer acknowledged and prefers deferral. They're happy to receive corrected invoice and will approve JE on their end if needed.
Maria (Finance): Closing action items: - I will post JR-2024-0917 once approval received - Elliot to attach corrected invoice to JR - Ben to update Rev schedule for Apr+ recognition. Closing on our side, will update month-end close checklist. Thanks everyone.
